reason: Second adversarial pass extends rather than overwrites the existing complete S16 shard.

overturned_rejection.prior: Using float for PEN is automatically a correctness defect.
overturned_rejection.why: Canonical S02 explicitly says montos en soles use Decimal rather than float. S16 uses float for PEN without declaring a conversion boundary.

amend_existing.note: The parser inconsistently deletes invalid characters, silently converts some malformed inputs and crashes on others.

new_findings.evidence: S16 calls normalized PEN outputs floats and norm_money returns float; S02 established Decimal for soles.
new_findings.learner_failure_mode: A learner can discard the earlier Decimal-for-money contract during cleaning and later aggregate approximate binary floats as canonical PEN.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Parse canonical PEN to Decimal. Teach any later Decimal-to-float analytics boundary explicitly.

new_findings.evidence: SeriesGroupBy.nunique defaults dropna=True. For one key with ['Lima', None], the canonical expression returns count 1.
new_findings.learner_failure_mode: A learner can label value-versus-missing sources as consistent when the attribute contract expects agreement.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Declare missing semantics per attribute; preclassify null disagreement or use dropna=False when missing is a distinct state.

new_findings.evidence: cat_map.get(x.upper(), x.title()) promotes every unknown non-null token to a clean-looking title-cased category.
new_findings.learner_failure_mode: A learner can let typos/new category codes enter clean data without an unmapped-category signal.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Normalize text, then validate against the category map/allowlist; unknown values get an explicit reason.

new_findings.evidence: The prose says stat outliers are flagged and quarantined, then says plausible 5000 must remain visible to S17; code marks 5000 stat-only, not domain_error.
new_findings.learner_failure_mode: A learner can quarantine legitimate tail observations solely because IQR flagged them.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Domain errors quarantine; stat-only plausible extremes stay clean with a flag unless a separate policy says otherwise.

new_findings.evidence: Events contain event/n/reason but no run_id, timestamp, source/input hash, contract version or row/rule references.
new_findings.learner_failure_mode: A learner can keep ordered events that still cannot reconstruct which run/input/rules they audit.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Add run_id, observed_at, input/source id+hash, contract_version and row/rule references.

new_findings.evidence: Figure alt says 'politicas' without accent and learner copy alternates portfolio/portafolio.
new_findings.learner_failure_mode: No technical misconception, but accessibility-facing copy and editorial consistency remain below publication standard.

paragraph_amendments.improved_version: Declara exact_cols/conflict_attrs y la política de missing. Si ausencia frente a valor observado cuenta como discrepancia, no permitas que el dropna=True por defecto la borre. S17 enseñará groupby/transform; S16 debe enseñar primero la política.
Normaliza representación y después valida categorías. Un token fuera del mapa queda unmapped; no se vuelve válido solo por title-casing.
Valida el token PEN completo y conviértelo al Decimal canónico de S02. Un formato/moneda no permitido conserva raw y produce invalid_money_format.
Los montos PEN permitidos producen Decimal; fechas que no parsean producen invalid_date_format; categorías no mapeadas producen unmapped_category. Raw permanece intacto.
Domain error bloquea o cuarentena. Un stat_outlier dentro del dominio queda en clean con flag/review; IQR por sí solo no lo excluye.
5000 permanece en clean con stat_outlier=True; -1 entra a cuarentena por domain_error_monto. Así S17 conserva la cola legítima.

El audit del lab identifica run, tiempo, input/source, versión del contrato y regla/filas. Una lista solo modela orden; no garantiza append-only. El entrypoint emite métricas y luego devuelve un exit status coherente.
